chunks: Muhammad b. 'Ali b. al-Fadl al-Kufi (ra) narrated to us in the Mosque of Amir al-Mu'minin (as) in Kufa... Harun b. Kharija narrated to us. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (as) said to me:

How far is your house from the Mosque of Kufa? So I informed him. He said: There has not been an Angel of Proximity, nor a commissioned prophet, nor a righteous servant that entered Kufa except that he prayed in it. The Messenger of Allah (s) passed by it on his Night Journey, the angel sought permission, and he prayed two units there. An obligatory prayer in it is worth a thousand prayers, a voluntary prayer is worth five hundred, and sitting in it without even reciting the Quran is worship. So go to it, even if you must crawl.

key_terms.أُسْرِيَ بِهِ: The Night Journey (Isra), the Prophet's miraculous journey to the heavens
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ الْفَرِيضَةُ: Obligatory prayer, whose reward is multiplied a thousandfold in this mosque
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ الْكُوفَةِ: The Mosque of Kufa, one of the most sacred mosques in Shia Islam

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of the Mosque of Kufa according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq told Harun b. Kharija about the extraordinary virtue of the Mosque of Kufa: every angel, prophet, and righteous person who entered Kufa prayed there. The Prophet prayed there during his Night Journey. An obligatory prayer there equals a thousand, voluntary equals five hundred, and merely sitting there is worship.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Fadl al-Kufi (ra) narrated to us in the Mosque of Amir al-Mu'minin (as) in Kufa. He said: Muhammad b. Ja`far known as Ibn Tibyan narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Qasim al-Nahmi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi narrated to us. He said: Tawba b. al-Khalil narrated to us. He said: I heard Muhammad b. al-Hasan say: Harun b. Kharija narrated to us. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said to me:

How far is your house from the Mosque of Kufa? So, I informed him. So, he said: There has not been an Angel of Proximity nor a commissioned prophet nor a righteous servant that entered Kufa except that he prayed in it. Surely, the Messenger of Allah (s) passed by it on his Night Journey. He sought the angel’s permission, then prayed two units there. An obligatory prayer in it is worth one thousand prayers. A voluntary prayer in it is worth five hundred prayers. Sitting in it without [even] reciting the Quran is [considered] worship. So, go to it, even if you must crawl.
